title: klayout-tools generic (technology-independent) gate netlist
description: An engine-agnostic, technology-independent gate-level netlist -- the input Epic #704 Phase 2's technology-mapping stage maps onto a PDK's Liberty-described standard-cell library. Flat single-module scope: no sub-module instantiation. See docs/design/synth-techmap-stage-contract.md (issue #873) for the full contract, the ten-primitive cell vocabulary, and the interim Yosys-derived on-ramp before a native elaboration stage exists.

schema.description: Format identifier + major version. Bump the trailing integer only on a breaking (non-additive) change to this shape.

ports.description: The module's primary input/output/inout ports, in declaration order.

name.description: Port name as declared in the source RTL (e.g. "a" for a bus, "clk" for a scalar).

direction.description: "inout" is accepted structurally (a tri-state I/O pad) but unmapped by the v1 technology-mapping stage -- see docs/design/synth-techmap-stage-contract.md section 8.

bits.description: Ordered list (MSB-first for a bus) of individual net names this port expands to -- "a[3]", "a[2]", ... for a 4-bit bus, "[\"clk\"]" for a scalar. Matches native/statime/src/netlist.rs's own bit-naming convention for the mapped-netlist dialect one stage downstream.

cells.description: Generic-cell instances forming the design's combinational/sequential logic.

name.description: Instance name, unique within the module.

type.description: One of the ten v1 technology-independent primitives -- see docs/design/synth-techmap-stage-contract.md section 2.2 for each type's pin list and function.

connections.description: Maps each pin name the cell `type` declares (e.g. {"A", "B", "Y"} for $and2; {"D", "CLK", "Q"}, optionally plus "RST"/"EN", for $dff) to a connected net name -- either one of `ports[].bits` or an implicit internal net not declared elsewhere.
